lines: It was a stout arm which looked like exposed ore. And what was more, it was thicker than Yuri's torso.
If she were to take that head-on, her flesh would be squashed, her bones would buckle, and she probably wouldn't even retain her original shape.

Without changing the look on her face one bit, Yuri dodged the arm that had swung downward with a whoosh, slipped smoothly past the side of that giant body, and closed in on the witch, her assassination target.
The witch widened her eyes in shock.
Terror surfaced in the depths of those red irises.
The two kodachi sharply cleaved the witch apart.
First her head tumbled to the floor, and next, her upper half slid down diagonally.
And then, as if reluctant to leave, on a slight delay, everything from her waist down toppled forward.
Just as she had been cut to pieces and reduced to a corpse, the witch's form changed.
No, wrong. This wasn't the target witch.
It was a woman, her lady-in-waiting or something.
That voice had come from behind Yuri.
She tried to turn around, but it was too late.
A cold breath was breathed on the back of her neck.
Yuri tried to hold her breath, but she didn't manage in time.
Her entire body went numb in a flash.
She became unable to move a finger anymore.
She was frozen like a marionette, still in a posture of trying to turn around.
The witch chuckled as she tilted her head and peered at the immobilized Yuri's face.
「Did they hire you for pocket change? Relax. I'm not going to kill you.」
「I know. I'll sell you off to a slave trader, and make you live a miserable life as a slave whore for the rest of your days♪ It's a light punishment, considering.」
「What's the matter? Why don't you say something? I've made it so that you're able to use your mouth.」
「What a bore! How about saying something?」
「Also, what's with that blindfold? Have you such a homely face that you need to hide it?」
The witch reached a pale hand out, and suddenly took off Yuri's blindfold.
The eyes that had been concealed.
「My, isn't that a lovely face? I wonder if I should give up on selling you, and have some fun myself?」
「I know. I'll peel off your skin, little by little. I'm going to enjoy messing up that pretty face!」
While staring fixedly at the witch with those eyes.
The centres of her eyes were beginning to glow brilliantly.
She was about to make a derisive sneer, as if boasting of her victory,
When all of a sudden, she screwed her face up stiffly.
Before she knew it, the witch herself had become unable to move as well.
Though she wasn't aware of it herself, that laugh was kind of sadistic.
「Don't play dumb! Golem, crush this woman!」
However, the Otherworld giant didn't so much as twitch.
It was standing in the corridor like a mere statue.
She realized that her own hand had raised without her knowing it.
It was not by the witch's will.
The next thing she knew, there it was.
The witch's own hand, which had sharp claws, was right next to her stiffened face.
「Your nails are pretty long, aren't they?」
「You're going to flay the skin off my face with those claws, yes?」
Her own nails dug into her cheek.
Making an unpleasant tearing sound, the witch's claws ripped apart not just her skin, but even the flesh underneath.
Five ugly red lines ran deep along it, and blood gushed from her gouged-out cheek flesh.
「What's wrong, scratching your own face all of a sudden?」
Yuri stared fixedly at the witch with those eyes of hers.
The witch's hand started moving again.
Twice, three times, four times...... It wouldn't stop.
She repeatedly, repeatedly dug her nails in, so as to gouge even deeper into her scratch marks.
In less than 30 seconds, the witch's face was torn to shreds.
Both cheeks were ripped apart repeatedly, and one could even see the inside of her mouth from the outside.
Her thin eyelids were shredded as well, and even the surface of her eyeballs was scraped away. She couldn't see anything anymore.
Her bright-red lips were split vertically like bamboo blinds, even the tongue inside her mouth was cut to ribbons, and bloody saliva wouldn't stop.
「Do you want to peel off your own face that badly?」
Yuri said, with an unchanging smile on her face.
「Wh...... Whah dih...... ya do da meh?!」
The witch let out a garbled voice.
With her cheeks, mouth and tongue in shreds, she couldn't utter proper words anymore.
「Ahh's a lie!! A lahee!! Bueeze, sdob, szob id!! Gugyaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!!」
Her ghastly screams carried on for some time, but eventually, the witch fainted from fear of Yuri, and agony that had gone beyond her limit.
「If you hadn't said something distasteful, you wouldn't have suffered such a painful experience, though.」
Yuri's numbness had also worn off. She brandished her kodachi.
She casually cut off the witch's head, delivering the finishing blow like it was nothing.
And then, as she was about to sheathe her short swords,
She suddenly pressed firmly on her eyes.
Her entire body was shaking slightly.
Cold sweat wouldn't stop flooding out.
They throbbed to an abnormal degree.
It was because she had used her power.
However, that pain had been getting more and more serious of late.
「I'm almost at my limit. I'll have to find a Demonologist......」
Yuri reaffixed her eye mask with trembling hands, and left the mansion, which no longer had a master.
